The structure of Cr₄Cd₄Ge₄S₁₆ (reduced formula CrCdGeS₄) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 28 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd and Cr each adopt octahedral coordination by six S atoms, while Ge is tetrahedrally coordinated by four S atoms. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cd and Cr octahedra, corner- and edge-sharing between Cd octahedra and Ge tetrahedra, and edge-sharing among like Cd octahedra and like Ge tetrahedra.
